resources.string: Offline, subtle mouth-corner adjustment. Smile lifts corners; Relax smile reduces existing lift. It cannot generate teeth or close an open mouth. Choose the face from left to right in group photos.
No usable mouth landmarks found after checking image orientations. Try a larger, clearer face with both mouth corners visible. Profiles, masks and blur can prevent detection.
Could not adjust or save this photo. Try a smaller export or another photo.
Default export: up to 2048 px. Original resolution uses more memory. The original photo stays unchanged.
